spec.description: Full-text post search, paged by cursor.

request.title: SearchPostsRequest
request.description: The query, the order and the page.

q.description: Search string. Lucene-style syntax is accepted.

author.description: Only posts by this account, as a handle or DID.

lang.description: Only posts in this language, as a BCP 47 tag.

limit.description: Rows per page. Range [1, 100]; defaults to 25.

cursor.description: Opaque page token from the previous response; omit for the first page.
Token for the next page; absent on the last one.

hitsTotal.description: Approximate total number of matches, when the search backend reports one.

unverified.detail: The public AppView answers `app.bsky.feed.searchPosts` with HTTP 403 to an unauthenticated caller, unlike every other endpoint here. Recording it needs a session against a PDS (an app password), which this client does not carry; the schema is therefore still written from the lexicon and unconfirmed.

notes: Written from the `app.bsky`/`com.atproto` lexicons as remembered, not read: the docs host was unreachable. The schema is a subset of the lexicon; undeclared fields pass validation and are dropped from the validated value. The first recording confirms or corrects it.

Search is the one endpoint of the twelve the public AppView will not serve without a session. The first Record run got `HTTP 403` and an HTML block page from `public.api.bsky.app`, deterministically, while the other ten answered; so this is not a bad day for the endpoint, it is the AppView's policy, and the endpoint stays `unverified` until the project has a credential to record with.
